parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance.

> Call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of RD member accounts to return. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token for a paged query. If this is your first query, leave this parameter empty.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).
